data.name: skb.subtitle
data.value: Master switches for the user-portal knowledge base and agents' canned responses.

data.name: skb.enableHelp
data.value: FAQ articles and search appear on the user portal. When off, the portal's Knowledge Base section is hidden entirely; existing articles are not deleted, only unpublished.

data.name: skb.requireLoginHelp
data.value: Only signed-in users can read articles. Recommended if your articles describe company-specific processes (payroll calendars, approval flows and the like).

data.name: skb.cannedHelp
data.value: Agents can insert prepared boilerplate answers with one click while replying. When off, the canned-response menu in the reply box is hidden.

data.name: skb.banner
data.value: Articles, categories and canned-response content are managed in the agent panel's Knowledge Base section:
